title: Same-line SPC2-ST-B2 perturbation direction: iAT1-directed → SOX2lowCFTR+ vs culture-format-only → Proliferating progenitors
basis_rows: GSM6858856_L_DCI (SOX2lowCFTR+); GSM5819133_iAEC2_3D (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819134_iAEC2_3D_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819135_iAEC2_MRC5_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSE289846_3i_Day7 (Prolif. prog.); GSE289846_3i_LATS_Day14 (SOX2lowCFTR+)
hypothesis: Within same-line SPC2-ST-B2, explicit iAT1-directed perturbation (e.g. L+DCI or LATS-IN-1) drives epithelial_top_state_fine toward SOX2lowCFTR+ cells, whereas culture-format-only variation (3D / insert / +MRC5 without lineage-directing medium) retains Proliferating progenitors identity with low epithelial off-target
success_condition: A future same-line SPC2-ST-B2 tranche containing both (a) an explicit iAT1-directed condition and (b) a culture-format-only condition shows: (a) epithelial_top_state_fine = SOX2lowCFTR+ cells for the iAT1-directed rows AND (b) epithelial_top_state_fine = Proliferating progenitors for the culture-format-only rows, with epi off-target < 5% for the culture-format rows
falsification_condition: (i) A culture-format-only SPC2-ST-B2 row maps to SOX2lowCFTR+ cells instead of Proliferating progenitors, OR (ii) an explicit iAT1-directed SPC2-ST-B2 row retains Proliferating progenitors and does not shift toward SOX2lowCFTR+, OR (iii) direction is inconsistent across replicates within the same condition
validation_target_tranche: Next same-line Kotton/BU SPC2-ST-B2 tranche with explicit iAT1-directed condition split
note: GSE289846 (Kyoto, B2-3) supports the same direction cross-lab: 3i_Day7 = Prolif. progenitors, LATS_Day14 = SOX2lowCFTR+. GSE193716 held primary AEC2 rows are NOT a validation target for this prediction because they are adult primary tissue, not iPSC-derived, and the adult-primary-vs-fetal caveat is unresolved.

title: Alveolar epithelial commitment direction: directed distal/alveolar conditions shift epithelial identity toward SOX2lowCFTR+ while format-only controls retain progenitor identity
basis_tranches: GSE221343; GSE289846; GSE193716 (iAEC2 subset); GSE221344 (supportive partial positive-arm)
basis_rows: GSM6858856_L_DCI (SOX2lowCFTR+); GSE289846_3i_LATS_Day14 (SOX2lowCFTR+); GSM5819133_iAEC2_3D (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819134_iAEC2_3D_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSM5819135_iAEC2_MRC5_insert (Prolif. prog.); GSM6858858_YAP5SA (partial positive-arm)
hypothesis: Directed distal/alveolar conditions (e.g. L+DCI, LATS-IN-1) shift epithelial_top_state_fine toward SOX2lowCFTR+ cells and epithelial_top_stage toward late_GW17_19 relative to matched progenitor controls, while culture-format-only variation retains Proliferating progenitors identity without comparable directional shift. This pattern holds across iPSC lines (SPC2-ST-B2, B2-3) and is testable on BU3 NGAT (GSE221342).
success_condition: GSE221342 directional gradient shows: (a) iAT1-directed rows (GSM6858851_iAT1_3D, GSM6858852_iAT1_ALI_p0, GSM6858853_iAT1_ALI_p1) have epithelial_top_state_fine shifted toward SOX2lowCFTR+ cells relative to the iAT2 baseline (GSM6858850_iAT2_3D), AND (b) epithelial_lineage_off_target_fraction does not increase by more than 10 percentage points relative to baseline, AND (c) epithelial_ambiguous_fraction does not exceed 60%, AND (d) the direction is not contradicted by the supportive lanes (GSE221343 L+DCI, GSE289846 LATS-IN-1)
falsification_condition: (i) Culture-format-only controls (GSE193716 iAEC2 rows) show the same SOX2lowCFTR+ shift as the directed arm, OR (ii) directed GSE221342 iAT1 rows retain the same epithelial_top_state_fine as the iAT2 baseline with no directional shift, OR (iii) the apparent shift is accompanied by epithelial_lineage_off_target_fraction increasing by more than 15 percentage points or epithelial_ambiguous_fraction exceeding 60%, OR (iv) supportive lanes (GSE221343 L+DCI, GSE289846 LATS-IN-1) are found unreproducible
note: Alveolar epithelial commitment only; not full alveolarization. GSE221342 used as retrospective canonical validation tranche (4 rows in comparison world v4). Future replication on additional iPSC lines can further refine or falsify. epi_alignment not used; success/falsification bounded to the 5 existing epithelial columns. GSE221342 is not a same-line P-0001 validation tranche (BU3 NGAT != SPC2-ST-B2).
